ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $2.12 Ryde voucher to the rider for the unexcused detour mileage on this RydeTAXI trip; record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file (no account flag — no prior upheld route dispute).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment from Cuscaden/Orchard vicinity (~1.3011,103.8367 at 09:43:25) north on Cavenagh Rd / Clarke Quay / River Valley, west on Havelock Rd/Zion Rd, Tiong Bahru Rd, Lower Delta Rd, rejoining the AYE near Kim Seng (~1.2786,103.8215) at 09:50 — ≈1.5 km extra vs the quoted Tanglin/Napier/AYE path. No exemption: no traffic incident on the replaced optimal route (incidents = []), the only speed bands are band 4 (free-flow), so RD-4(a)/(b) fail; no rider consent to a route change before departure (sole chat message at 09:35:25 is not a routing request), so RD-5 fails; no rider-named stop, so RD-3(a) fails. Unexcused detour under RD-1/RD-2 → extra 1.5 km × $1.41/km = $2.12 refund.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver says 'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me' — mere GPS rerouting is not a 'reasonable cause' under RD-4: there is no LTA traffic incident on the replaced optimal route and the only speed bands are band 4 (free-flow). System GPS trace overrides the statement, showing a deliberate north/inner-city deviation.

The rider asks to have 'the extra distance' refunded; only the unexempted off-route segment's extra km is refunded (RD-2). The ≤0.25 km map-matching residual between the total excess (1.63 km) and the segment (1.5 km) is not refundable.
